title: mxr
description: Agent-first, local-first email client in Rust. A background daemon syncs Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft 365 and IMAP into SQLite and keeps a Tantivy search index. The terminal UI, CLI, web app, MCP server and agent skill are thin clients on the same API, so an agent can do anything a person can. Every mutating command has a dry run, and a pre-send check catches missing attachments, leaked secrets and reply-all mistakes.
